messages:
alyssa: Heads-up — saw a spike of 413s on /v1/embeddings this morning for mixed-dim payloads from search-service. Console trace: `X-Vector-Dims: [64, 512, 64]`, batch size ~12. Anyone else seeing this? 

ben: Yep. Our preflight currently treats mixed dims as a hard reject because the sharder needs uniform dims to allocate. That explains the 413s.

cate: Can we do a soft-fallback? Auto-split the batch by dim, route each chunk to appropriate pool. That will add a bit of latency but avoids customer errors.

ben: Splitting is doable but the current runtime optimization expects contiguous batches for batching efficiency. Splitting increases overhead — p50 +20-40ms depending on cache hits. Also costs go up.

mike: We need dashboard signals before rolling anything. Proposal: surface `embed.preflight.fail_rate` and `embed.split_rate` and add a breakdown by `requested_dims` in the console. We should also show `split_latency_p50/p95` and cost delta estimate per route.

infra-bot: Logs: `413 Payload Too Large -> mixed-dims` x86 nodes spike at 07:12 UTC, 217 failures across 5 mins. Attaching sample header dump.

devex-bot: Note — client SDKs started shipping `X-Vector-Dims` header last week (v2.3.1). Some callers still send legacy shapes without header; the splitter falls back to shape detection which is brittle.

alyssa: UX thought: in Console per-route settings add: [ ] Auto-split mixed dims (beta)  and a `preferred_dim` hint. If auto-split on, show expected latency and cost impact inline.

cate: Heuristic idea: if batch <= 8 => auto-split; if batch > 8 => prefer fail (fast fail) unless route flagged for `background` QoS. That keeps tail latency bounded.

ben: Agreed. Also add a hard quota path: if total payload bytes > route.max_bytes => reject before split to avoid OOM.

mike: For telemetry to compare rollout: collect `embed.error_rate`, `embed.split_success_rate`, `embed.fallback_model_rate`, `embeds.cost_estimate_delta`. Canary the feature behind ff: `embeds-mixed-dim-split-v1`, 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 24h gates.

alyssa: Quick pseudo-config:
```
if mixed_dims:
  if len(batch) <= 8:
    split_by_dim()
  elif route.qos == 'background':
    split_by_dim(async=True)
  else:
    reject(413, hint='try smaller batch or enable auto-split')
```

ben: Let's also add server-side metric tags: `route`, `customer_tier`, `requested_dim_set` so dashboards can slice.

cate: Action items:
- add telemetry metrics + console cards (mike)
- implement preflight heuristic + unit tests (ben)
- console toggle + UX copy (alyssa)
- SDK note about header required (devex-bot)

alyssa: OK assigning — mike (dashboards), ben (runtime), me (console copy & rollout), devex-bot will draft SDK note. Can we target canary next week? :rocket: 

mike: SGTM. I'll stub dashboard panels and add alerts on `embed.preflight.fail_rate > 0.5%` per-route.

ben: I'll prototype splitter in `embed-preflight` branch and push a canary build. Keep an eye on p95 latency.

infra-bot: Canary deployed to 5% at 2023-11-07T09:00Z (simulated). Observability hooks attached.

alyssa: Thanks all — follow-up in #eng-platform tomorrow with initial numbers.
